title: verbascum serpenticola
intro: Verbascum serpenticola, commonly known as the serpent mullein, is a plant species in the figwort family native to the mountainous regions of the western United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as treating respiratory issues, reducing inflammation, and soothing skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Verbascum serpenticola include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it an effective remedy for colds, coughs, and other respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Verbascum serpenticola include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
